cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Come paint the old kitchen with me. Since Dad died, I barely see you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay someone. I can't face painting over his height marks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We'll keep them. Come help me tape around them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probably just sit on the floor and cry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll sit with you. We can leave the paint unopened; I don't want us only meeting to empty his house.

mechanism: A directs a shared task and then permits grief to replace it, insisting on presence because the sibling connection matters more than painting.
confusable: D74 holds someone until a rupture is repaired; D73 asks ongoing presence as evidence of connection even without a specific dispute.
comparison: Bereaved siblings sharing a house task differ from a parent attending an adult child opening around divorce tensions.
seedUse: Use D73-a height-mark preservation and willingness to leave paint unopened; make supervisory permissions shape the compassionate invitation.
